niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with clear hierarchy, structured sections, and explicit labels. They often favor light neutral backgrounds with dark text and restrained accent usage, but will also choose dark themes when they feel premium, warm-toned, focused, and information-rich rather than decorative or cluttered. They like compact but organized layouts, card-based grouping, visible action buttons, labeled navigation, readable status encoding, and concise supportive detail. They dislike oversized decorative icons, floating or icon-only actions, weak hierarchy, low-contrast text, and visually noisy layouts.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong visual hierarchy with clear section titles, summaries, subtitles, labels, and readable contrast so content structure is immediately understandable.

Prefers organized layouts with segmented regions, card-based grouping, list rows, multi-column or clearly separated sections, and explicit form structure rather than continuous or weakly organized layouts.

Most often prefers light neutral backgrounds with dark text and subtle accents; when dark themes are preferred, they tend to be warm, premium, high-contrast, and controlled rather than harsh or electric.
Prefers interfaces that show useful supporting detail upfront—metrics, metadata, summaries, reassurance text, or contextual information—without becoming confusing.
Prefers obvious, text-labeled actions, strong primary CTAs, bottom bars or visible toolbars, and explicit controls over floating, hidden, or icon-only actions.
Prefers polished, formal or premium presentation with restrained decoration, fewer distractions, and a focused interface rather than playful, dramatic, or marketing-heavy styling.
Prefers balanced spacing that keeps content readable and grouped, avoiding both excessive empty space from oversized elements and overly crowded visual packing.
